D: Interlinked stories of LA gangsters, boxers and a briefcase.
P: Serve the shakes at Jack Rabbit Slim's.
S: Vincent's Amsterdam story, the little differences
Beef sliders smashed thin, American cheese, onion, pickle, mustard and a dab of mayo the European way, on soft buns.

Mini beef patties glazed in sticky homemade teriyaki with charred pineapple, cheddar and a sriracha mayo in soft slider buns, skewered with a toothpick. Simmer 80ml soy sauce, 80ml mirin and 2 tbsp brown sugar for 5 minutes until syrupy. Shape 500g beef mince into 12 small patties and season. Grill 4 pineapple rings until charred and cut each into 3. Cook the patties on a hot griddle 2 minutes a side, brush with teriyaki and add a small square of cheddar. Mix 80g mayonnaise with 1 tbsp sriracha. Build in 12 slider buns with pineapple and mayo.
Thin fries soaked an hour, blanched at 140C, fried at 190C, salted, served in red-checked paper boats with ketchup and mustard.
M: Thick chuck patty brushed with teriyaki (soy, mirin, sugar reduced), grilled pineapple ring, cheddar and lettuce on a toasted bun.
Vincent's order at Jack Rabbit Slim's, bloody as hell

Sirloin seared hard and served properly rare, with skin-on fries, a little pot of peppercorn sauce and a crisp iceberg wedge with blue cheese dressing. Season 4 sirloin steaks an hour ahead. Fry 800g frozen skin-on fries at 220C for 25 minutes. Sear the steaks in a smoking pan for 2 minutes a side until 48C inside, then rest 5 minutes. In the same pan, cook 1 chopped shallot and 1 tbsp crushed peppercorns, add 30ml brandy and 150ml cream and simmer 2 minutes. Cut 1 iceberg into wedges and spoon over 120g blue cheese mixed with 80g sour cream.
W: the opening scene at the diner, before the robbery
Buttermilk pancakes cooked in butter, stacked with butter and maple syrup, a side of crisp bacon.
K: vanilla, and it really is worth it
Blend 3 scoops vanilla bean ice cream with 120ml cold full cream milk until just thick enough for a straw to stand up. Whipped cream and a cherry.

flavour.sign: Los Angeles. Booths are cars, waiters are film stars.

note.text: Mia picked the place and the five dollar shake. I picked the steak, bloody, and I'm not dancing tonight.

steps.text: Divide the mince into 12 small balls and dice the onion.
Smash the balls into thin patties on a hot griddle, salt well and flip after a minute or two.

Fill soft buns with the patties, onion, pickle, mustard and a dab of mayonnaise, the way they do it in Amsterdam.

veg.make_ahead: Mash the blue cheese with the sour cream up to 2 days ahead, keep chilled; cook the cauliflower steaks, fries and sauce on the night

steps.text: Cut two 3cm thick steaks from the middle of each cauliflower, season with salt and brush with 2 tbsp of the oil.
Bake the frozen skin-on fries at 220C for 25 minutes until crisp.
Sear the cauliflower steaks in the remaining oil and the butter in a hot ovenproof pan for 3 minutes a side, then roast at 220C for 15 minutes until tender in the middle.
Wipe out the pan, cook the shallot and crushed peppercorns for 1 minute, add the brandy, stock and cream and simmer for 3 minutes.
Cut the iceberg lettuce into wedges and spoon over the blue cheese mashed with the sour cream. Serve with the cauliflower steaks, fries and peppercorn sauce.

steps.text: Simmer the soy, mirin and sugar until syrupy.
Grill the pineapple rings until charred.
Brush the mushrooms with the oil and grill them gill side down for 4 minutes, then flip, press flat and cook 4 minutes more, brushing with the teriyaki.
Grill the haloumi slices for 2 minutes a side, brush with teriyaki and sit one on each mushroom. Top with the cheddar to melt.
Toast the buns and build with lettuce, mushroom and haloumi, and pineapple.

dishes.make_ahead: Batter up to 1 day ahead, keep chilled

steps.text: Whisk the flour, baking powder, sugar, buttermilk and eggs until just combined.
Rest the batter for 15 minutes (included in cook time).
Cook ladlefuls in butter in a frying pan until bubbles set, flip and cook through, keeping the stack warm.
Grill the bacon until crisp. Stack the pancakes with butter and maple syrup, with bacon on the side.

Add 15ml vanilla syrup to each glass, or half a teaspoon of vanilla extract with a teaspoon of sugar syrup.
Top each with 300ml cold cola and stir once.

s.how: Smash 12 small patties from 500g beef mince on a hot griddle, salt and flip, adding American cheese. Put on soft slider buns with diced onion, pickle, mustard and a dab of mayo, the way they do it in Amsterdam.
Cut 1kg russets into thin fries and soak an hour, then dry well. Fry at 140C for 5 minutes, rest, then at 190C until crisp. Salt and serve in red-checked paper boats with tomato sauce and mustard.

m.how: Simmer 60ml soy, 60ml mirin and 2 tbsp brown sugar until syrupy. Grill 4 pineapple rings until charred. Grill 4 thick chuck patties, brushing with the teriyaki, then melt cheddar on top. Build on toasted buns with lettuce and pineapple.
